title: Algerian Tofu Tagine
description: A comforting and flavorful North African dish made with tender tofu and aromatic spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay or ceramic pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the cumin, cayenne pepper, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add 1 cup of water to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 15-20 minutes or until the tofu is tender.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Serve with couscous or crusty bread for a comforting meal.
